items.review_rationale: Read objects, hom-categories, 1-morphisms, 2-morphisms, strict composition functors, identity laws and interchange; this is strictly associative, unlike an arbitrary weak bicategory.

references.context: Objects and arrows respectively of each hom-category C(X,Y), with 1-morphisms between objects X,Y.
Composition C(Y,Z)×C(X,Y)→C(X,Z) preserving the internal morphism structure of the hom-categories.
Compatibility between horizontal and vertical compositions of 2-morphisms.

references.disposition: Composition and identity constraints are equalities, not merely specified coherent natural isomorphisms.

items.review_rationale: Read irreducible components of the affine spectrum as closed subsets V(p) for minimal prime ideals of the ring, preserving the ordering on primes and the Zariski topology.

references.context: Prime ideal p minimal in the partially ordered collection of prime ideals of R, not necessarily a minimal nonzero ideal.
Set of prime ideals q with p⊆q, endowed with subspace topology of the Zariski spectrum.

references.phrase: exactly the components V(p) for minimal primes
references.disposition: An algebraic characterization of maximal irreducible closed subsets; it does not claim all prime ideals give distinct components.
